professional_summary: Operations manager with more than 12 years of experience leading logistics, warehousing and customer service teams across retail and third-party logistics environments. Demonstrated capability in standardising processes, strengthening safety performance and building accountable, high-performing teams. Recognised for translating business priorities into practical operating plans and maintaining service continuity through periods of growth and change.

professional_experience.scope_statement: Lead a 45-person distribution centre servicing major retail clients across New South Wales and the ACT.
achievements: Reduced order picking errors by 30 per cent by introducing barcode verification and structured team leader coaching.
Led the transition to a new warehouse management system, coordinating vendors, IT and floor teams to go live without service disruption.
Strengthened safety performance by standardising pre-start meetings, incident reporting and contractor inductions.
Partnered with key retail clients to redesign peak-season staffing plans and escalation pathways.
Supervised inbound and outbound teams of up to 20 staff across two shifts.
Introduced cycle counting procedures that improved stock accuracy and reduced end-of-year stocktake effort.
Trained new team leaders in rostering, performance conversations and safe work procedures.
Led a customer service team handling delivery enquiries and complaints for metropolitan stores.

education_and_training.qualification: Certificate IV in Work Health and Safety

awards.details: Recognised for safety and service results during network expansion.
